about_the_game:
Woofy Run is a fast-paced multiplayer dog parkour game. Players race through chaotic obstacle courses, attack their rivals to push them off the track, and fiercely compete to reach the finish line first.

Choose your favorite dog breed, customize it with funny outfits, and race against your friends in lively, dangerous arenas. Use your reflexes and strategy to dodge obstacles, attack at the right moment, and eliminate your opponents. You can bite your rivals to push them off the course, causing them to fall into water or off cliffs  and you’ll look hilarious while doing it. Bark and howl to challenge your rivals, celebrate your victory, or increase the chaos even further.

Core Features

Multiplayer Parkour Racing

Race through chaotic parkour courses with up to 5 players in real time. Create a private lobby, invite your friends, and race together in chaotic, fast-paced multiplayer races.

Offensive Combat Mechanics
Bite your opponents during races and use physical force to knock them off the track. A well-timed attack can cause rivals to fall into water, tumble off cliffs, or be completely eliminated.

Barking and Howling Interactions
Bark or howl during races to provoke your rivals, create fun moments with friends, or loudly celebrate your victory at the finish line.

Diverse Obstacle Courses
Run through themed maps such as city parks, amusement parks, forests, and space stations. Each course is filled with moving platforms, jump pads, and hazards that amplify player-driven chaos.

Full Dog Customization
Earn points during gameplay and spend them on costumes, hats, glasses, and accessories. Show off your style with cosmetic items.

Playable Breeds
Choose from 12 different dog breeds, including Labrador, Shiba Inu, Dalmatian, and Bulldog. Each breed features unique animations and optional abilities.

Leaderboards
Track the fastest players worldwide on each map. Save your personal best times, compare scores with friends, and race for the top.

Progression and Rewards
Complete challenges, unlock achievements, and earn points for new customizations. Seasonal events introduce limited-time challenges and exclusive cosmetics.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit / Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750-Ti / AMD RX 550, 2GB VRam
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit / Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 7500K / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580, 4GB VRam / Intel Arc A380
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Woofy Run is a multiplayer dog racing game where speed, strategy, and sabotage come together. Set traps, avoid obstacles, and race to be one of the top 10 fastest players on every map! Select your favourite dog and join the race!
